review_candidates.description: We're Hiring: Senior SEO Specialist – French Market 🇫🇷 Company: CompresserUneImage.fr Website: https://compresseruneimage.fr/ Position: Senior SEO Specialist Target Market: France Experience: 4+ Years Work Mode: Remote Employment Type: Full-time / Freelance – Open to discussion About the Project CompresserUneImage.fr is a French-language online image compression platform that helps users compress and optimize JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF images directly in their browsers. Our goal is to grow the platform's organic visibility in the French market, attract relevant French-speaking users, increase search traffic and establish the website as a trusted resource in the image optimization industry. We are looking for an experienced Senior SEO Specialist who understands the French search market and can develop and execute a complete SEO growth strategy. Key Responsibilities 1. French Market & Keyword Research Conduct in-depth keyword research specifically for Google France. Identify high-volume, low-competition and high-intent French keywords. Analyze search intent and keyword difficulty. Discover long-tail keywords and untapped organic opportunities. Build keyword clusters and topical maps. Identify opportunities for commercial, informational and tool-based keywords. Understand French search behavior and competitors. 2. Competitor Analysis Analyze major competitors such as TinyPNG, Squoosh, iLoveIMG and other French-market image optimization platforms. Identify their ranking keywords, backlink profiles and content strategies. Find keyword gaps and backlink opportunities. Develop strategies to compete with established websites. 3. Technical SEO Perform comprehensive technical SEO audits. Optimize website architecture, URLs and internal linking. Improve Core Web Vitals and page speed. Identify crawling, indexing and rendering issues. Optimize XML sitemaps, robots.txt and canonical tags. Implement and validate structured data and schema markup. Identify JavaScript SEO issues where relevant. 4. On-Page SEO Optimize title tags, meta descriptions and heading structures. Improve existing landing pages and tool pages. Optimize content for French search intent. Develop effective internal linking strategies. Improve topical relevance and semantic SEO. Optimize image SEO, alt text and image filenames. Improve CTR through search-result optimization. 5. Content Strategy & Topical Authority Develop a complete French content strategy. Build topical authority around image compression, image formats, optimization and related topics. Identify new article and landing-page opportunities. Create content briefs based on French SERP analysis. Improve existing content and avoid keyword cannibalization. Develop supporting content that attracts relevant organic traffic. Ensure content demonstrates expertise, experience, authority and trustworthiness (E-E-A-T). 6. Off-Page SEO & Link Building Develop a sustainable backlink acquisition strategy. Identify relevant French websites for guest posting and link insertions. Build relationships with French publishers, bloggers and industry websites. Analyze competitors' referring domains and backlink gaps. Focus on relevant, authoritative and quality backlinks. Monitor backlink growth and identify potentially harmful links. 7. SEO Performance & Reporting Manage Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4. Track keyword rankings in Google France. Monitor organic clicks, impressions, CTR and conversions. Analyze landing-page performance. Provide regular SEO performance reports. Develop actionable strategies based on data. 8. Advanced SEO & Future Search Understand modern SEO practices and Google's evolving algorithms. Experience with AI Search Optimization (AEO). Knowledge of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Understand how websites can improve visibility in AI-powered search experiences. Required Experience & Skills Minimum 4 years of hands-on SEO experience. Proven experience ranking websites in the French market. Strong understanding of Google France and French search behavior. Excellent French keyword research skills. Strong technical SEO knowledge. Experience with content optimization and topical authority. Proven link-building and digital PR experience. Strong competitor analysis skills. Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console and GA4. Ability to develop and execute an independent SEO strategy. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Important: We are looking for someone with practical SEO experience and proven results, not just theoretical knowledge. What We Expect From You We want someone who can take ownership of the SEO growth strategy for CompresserUneImage.fr. You should be able to: Audit the website and identify its biggest SEO opportunities. Develop a realistic 3–6 month SEO roadmap. Find opportunities to increase organic traffic in France. review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Site Acquisition Lead
review_candidates.description: Company Overview TransGrid Energy(“TGE”) is a renewable energy company focused on investing, developing, owning and operating utility-scale battery energy storage systems and PV projects. TransGrid has a robust pipeline of projects under construction and in late-stage development, and the Company is actively expanding its energy asset portfolio across the United States. As an affiliate company of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 company driven by a firm commitment to advancing the clean energy future, TransGrid Energy is striving to shape the renewable energy landscape by providing sustainable and reliable power solutions tailored to meet the energy needs of today and tomorrow. Position Overview As Manager, Site Acquisition Lead at TransGrid Energy, you will lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, and development of strategic sites for the company’s growing data center and energy infrastructure pipeline. This is a highly visible role responsible for securing the land and power infrastructure required to bring data center projects from initial site identification through site control and development. You will evaluate opportunities across land availability, power capacity, utility interconnection, fiber connectivity, zoning, permitting, water, environmental constraints, and overall development feasibility. The ideal candidate combines strong real estate and land acquisition expertise with a deep understanding of power availability, utility interconnection, data center development, energy infrastructure, and local entitlement processes. This individual has a proven track record of closing land transactions and working directly with utilities, brokers, developers, property owners, and local jurisdictions to turn potential sites into actionable development opportunities. Working closely with Power Systems Engineering, Development, Legal, Finance, and Executive Leadership, you will build and manage a high-quality site pipeline while determining which opportunities can deliver the required combination of land, power, infrastructure, timing, and economics. You will play a critical role in securing the sites and power capacity required to support TransGrid Energy’s next generation of data center projects. Responsibilities Identify, source, and evaluate potential data center sites based on power availability, utility interconnection, land characteristics, fiber connectivity, zoning, water availability, environmental considerations, and overall development feasibility. Lead the land acquisition process from initial site identification and property-owner outreach through LOIs, options, purchase agreements, leases, and other forms of site control. Negotiate directly with landowners, brokers, developers, and other stakeholders to secure favorable commercial terms and establish site control. Own power-procurement and utility due diligence in partnership with Power Systems Engineering, including evaluating available capacity, interconnection requirements, timelines, costs, and risks. Work directly with utilities and power providers to understand available capacity, infrastructure requirements, interconnection processes, development timelines, and potential constraints. Drive zoning, entitlement, permitting, and local development strategy in partnership with internal and external development resources. Build and maintain a qualified land and power pipeline, continuously evaluating and prioritizing opportunities based on development potential and strategic fit. Develop and maintain a feasibility view of each opportunity, including developable MW, land cost, power cost, infrastructure requirements, development schedule, and schedule-to-power. Evaluate site opportunities and make recommendations regarding which sites should advance based on land, power, infrastructure, entitlement, timing, and economic considerations. Coordinate cross-functional due diligence across real estate, power, engineering, legal, environmental, permitting, finance, and development teams. Track site acquisition milestones, critical path items, development risks, and required actions to maintain project schedules. Identify potential land, power, permitting, environmental, infrastructure, and schedule risks early and develop strategies to mitigate them. Build and maintain relationships with real estate brokers, landowners, utilities, developers, municipalities, economic development organizations, and other stakeholders relevant to data center development. Monitor data center development activity, power-market conditions, utility infrastructure investments, transmission and generation projects, and other market developments that may create new site opportunities. Represent TransGrid Energy in discussions with property owners, utilities, municipalities, brokers, developers, and other external stakeholders. Maintain accurate pipeline reporting and provide regular updates on site control, developable MW, power availability, schedule-to-power, land and power costs, and key development risks. Develop repeatable site-selection, acquisition, and evaluation processes that allow TransGrid Energy to efficiently scale its development pipeline. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. Required Qualifications Approximately 8+ years of experience in site selection, land acquisition, real estate development, data center development, energy infrastructure development, or a closely related field. Proven track record of successfully closing land transactions, including LOIs, options, leases, purchase agreements, or other forms of site control. Experience sourcing and evaluating sites for data centers, energy infrastructure, industrial development, power generation, or other large-scale infrastructure projects. Experience working with utilities on power availability, utility interconnection, infrastructure requirements, development timelines, or related power procurement activities. Strong understanding of the factors that determine whether a site can support a large-scale data center, including land, power, fiber, zoning, water, environmental constraints, and infrastructure. Experience navigating zoning, entitlements, permitting, environmental considerations, and local jurisdictional processes. Strong real estate negotiation skills, with the ability to work directly with property owners, brokers, developers, utilities, and other stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to evaluate development opportunities based on developable MW, cost per MW, schedule-to-power, land economics, infrastructure requirements, and development risk. Strong understanding of power markets and the practical challenges associated with securing significant electrical capacity for new developments. Existing relationships with utilities, real estate brokers, landowners, developers, municipalities, or other relevant stakeholders are highly valued. Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple potential sites and transactions simultaneously. Comfortable operating across strategy and execution, with a high level of ownership and a bias toward action. You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the process while executing the work. You don't need a pre-existing playbook; you want to help build one. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with property owners, utilities, government officials, technical teams, executives, and external partners. Bachelor's degree in real estate, engineering, business, or a related field preferred, but relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a specific degree. Travel may be required depending on business needs. WORK AUTHORIZATION The ideal candidate for this role will have authorization to work in the US prior to joining TransGrid Energy LLC. The Company will not sponsor or offer assistance with the sponsorship for work authorization in the United States. DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION TransGrid Energy believes that diversity and inclusion are vital to our success. We believe that by embracing different ideas and approaches, we enhance our ability to deliver the best results for our employees, our environment, and ultimately our business partners and customers. We foster a culture where all colleagues are able to share their passions and ideas in order that we may collectively embrace and overcome the challenges in our industry, and work toward a brighter future. TransGrid Energy is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class. Compensation Range: $185K - $195K

review_candidates.description: Company Description The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation. Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries. Job Description You will join our internal Global Talent Acquisition team as the specialist who leads senior and executive hiring across the entire Group, globally. This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who can flex between retained-style executive search methodology and fast-paced direct sourcing, depending on the seniority, urgency and complexity of each mandate. You will partner directly with Executive Board members, Segment Managers, brand CEOs/GMs and senior functional leaders to shape hiring strategy, build talent maps and close outstanding senior hires across EMEA, the Americas and APAC — bringing an executive search mindset in-house, with the speed and stakeholder proximity of an internal team. What You Will Do Own end-to-end senior, executive and leadership searches across the Group’s global brands and functions — from intake and search strategy through offer and close. Build talent maps, competitor mapping and market intelligence across enterprise software, SaaS, AEC/O technology and media technology. Headhunt proactively, engaging passive senior talent through executive search research techniques and modern tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean/X-ray, ATS, AI-enabled sourcing). Deliver senior hires across GTM (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, RevOps), Technical (Engineering, Product, R&D, Data/AI), Finance and HR/People — for both individual brands and corporate leadership. Advise hiring leaders and Board-level stakeholders on market conditions, talent availability, compensation positioning and search strategy. Run structured intake briefings and produce executive-ready shortlists, market maps and hiring committee materials. Deliver a high-touch, confidential candidate experience; design competency-based assessment and coach panels on structured, bias-aware interviewing. Maintain accurate pipeline and reporting data in our ATS, and champion AI-enabled sourcing and assessment tools to raise speed and quality. Share talent intelligence with the wider People team to inform workforce planning and succession pipelines. Qualifications Essential Typically 8+ years in senior/executive recruitment, combining retained executive search (in-house or agency) with contingency/direct-hire methods. Experience recruiting in software/technology — SaaS, enterprise software, AEC/O or related B2B tech strongly preferred — with credibility on product, GTM and technical topics. A track record of closing Senior Director, VP and C-suite appointments across several of: GTM, Engineering/Product, Finance and HR/People. Global search experience across multiple regions, with a grasp of international hiring practices and compensation structures. Proven ability to build talent-mapping and competitor-intelligence projects from scratch. Expert sourcing and headhunting capability, strong executive presence, and skill in structured senior-level assessment. Commercial judgement on compensation benchmarking and executive offer construction, plus discretion with confidential searches. Comfort operating autonomously in a matrixed, multi-brand global organisation Familiarity with modern recruitment technology (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms such as SuccessFactors/SmartRecruiters, AI-enabled sourcing and research tools). Nice to have In-house TA experience in a multi-brand, holding company or PE/portfolio structure. Partnering with Executive or Supervisory Boards on leadership hiring and succession planning. Exposure to AEC/O, construction technology, media/entertainment technology or vertical software markets. Additional Information Diversity, equal opportunity and inclusion are essential parts of our company culture and key drivers of our collective success. We therefore welcome applications from people of all genders, nationalities, ethnic and social backgrounds, religions and beliefs, sexual orientations and identities, age groups, and people with disabilities. Regardless of marital status or any other legally protected characteristic, we provide equal employment opportunities for all.

review_candidates.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC’s mission is to help people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their future. The International Rescue Committee is on the ground in more than 40 countries, providing emergency relief and rebuilding lives in the wake of disaster. Through 28 regional offices in cities across the United States, the IRC also helps refugees resettle in the US and become self-sufficient. The IRC is committed to a culture of bold leadership, innovation in all aspects of our work, creative partnerships and, most crucially, accountability to those we serve. The IRC is a tireless advocate for the most vulnerable. In all these programs, there is a drive to address the unique needs of women and girls (who represent the majority of those displaced) – and the universal barriers they face. The Awards Management Unit (AMU) is one of four pillars within CRRD . The unit is responsible for identifying, securing, and supporting the management of all funding from statutory/government donors. The AMU is a bridge between donors and country programs: providing expert technical advice to the country teams, while maintaining portfolio-level visibility to ensure consistency and compliance and manage risk. The regional team responds swiftly to country program needs, filling critical gaps and navigating access constraints, emergencies, and security shifts. WACAR focuses on cost-efficient and adaptive approaches to the evolving humanitarian and donor landscape, with a clear focus on resourcing country programs.
